parameters.query:
SELECT 
    p.id, 
    p.name AS referencia,
    p.title AS titulo, 
    p.price AS precio, 
    p.area AS metraje_m2, 
    p.bedrooms AS habitaciones, 
    p.street AS sector,
    p.city AS ciudad,
    COALESCE(t.name, 'Inmueble') AS tipo_propiedad,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.wp_post_id IS NOT NULL AND p.wp_post_id > 0 THEN 'https://inmobi.com.ec/?p=' || p.wp_post_id 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS link_propiedad,
    p.wp_post_id
FROM estate_property p 
LEFT JOIN estate_property_type t ON p.property_type_id = t.id 
WHERE p.state = 'available' 
  AND p.active = true
  AND p.price > 0
  AND (
    '{{ $json.ubicacion_norm || "" }}' = '' 
    OR lower(translate(coalesce(p.city,''), 'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ', 'aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.ubicacion_norm }}' || '%' 
    OR lower(translate(coalesce(p.street,''), 'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ', 'aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.ubicacion_norm }}' || '%'
    OR lower(translate(coalesce(p.title,''), 'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ', 'aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.ubicacion_norm }}' || '%'
    OR lower(translate(coalesce(p.sector_keywords,''), 'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ', 'aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.ubicacion_norm }}' || '%'
    OR lower(translate(coalesce(p.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.street,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.city,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.sector_keywords,''), 'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ', 'aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%' || replace('{{ $json.ubicacion_norm }}', ' ', '%') || '%'
  )
  AND p.price <= ({{ $json.presupuesto_max || $json.presupuesto || 999999999 }} * 1.10)
ORDER BY p.price ASC
LIMIT 10;
